lines.text: Recover what you can, separate evidence from guesses, and agree a maintenance baseline with a mechanic.
Missing paperwork is not a diagnosis.

eyebrow.text: The first five things to do

items.text: Record the VIN, year, model, engine or powertrain where known, current odometer reading and date.
Ask the seller for invoices, digital records and the shops used.
Get the manufacturer's manual and maintenance schedule for the correct year and version.
Check official recall information and arrange an independent inspection.

line.text: Mark its history unknown and nothing is assumed done. Items wait, honestly, until you have a real fact to record against them.
